source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

notes.saves: –2 status penalty to all saves vs. curses

items.name: –2 Status Penalty to All Saves vs. Curses
Hooked
items.text: A creature struck by Arth's fish hook is skewered, taking 1d4 persistent,bleed damage as long as the hook remains stuck. A creature can escape dc=28 from the hook.

items.name: Humiliate the Fish
items.text:
Requirements A creature is hooked by Arth's fish hook and adjacent to Arth

---
Effect Arth yanks the hook free, causing 4d8 slashing damage to the creature (DC 28 basic Fortitude save save), who also falls Prone if they fail that Fortitude save.

items.name: Reel In
items.text: Arth pulls the rope attached to his hook. If he has no creature hooked, the fish hook returns to his hand. If a creature is hooked, Arth attempts an Athletics check check against the creature's Fortitude DC, pulling it up to 30 feet closer on a success (60 feet on a critical success).

items.name: Swear
items.text: Arth unleashes a string of invectives. Each creature that hears him must attempt a DC 28 Will save save, with the effects of Mariner's Curse, and is then temporarily immune for 24 hours. Even on a failed save, the curse ends automatically after 24 hours.
